newsitem.title: INDIA: One killed, nine injured in Kashmir grenade attack.
newsitem.headline: One killed, nine injured in Kashmir grenade attack.

text.p: One person was killed and nine injured on Monday in a grenade attack by separatists at a crowded market-place in India's troubled Kashmir region, police said.
They said guerrillas hurled a grenade at a security patrol near the main bus station at Batamalo in Srinagar, summer capital of the northern state of Jammu and Kashmir.
The grenade missed the patrol and exploded on the road, injuring 10 pedestrians. One of the victims later died in hospital, a police spokesman said.
In a separate incident, one person died in Nowhatta, another Srinagar neighbourhood, when a hand grenade he was carrying exploded, police said.
More than a dozen militant groups are fighting for independence or merger with neighbouring Pakistan in Jammu and Kashmir, mainly Hindu India's only Moslem-majority state.
Police and hospitals say more than 20,000 people have been killed since the separatist rebellion broke out in 1990.
